thread:
Tyler: Heads-up — Monarch Systems (prospect) just sent a SIG/CAIQ (60 Qs). They want answers + evidence by EOD Friday. Can security intake + assign owners? Main asks: SSO/SAML, encryption-at-rest, data access controls, on-prem option, EU-only residency. Link attached.

Lina: Copy. Paste the questionnaire link and any redlines here? Also flag expected deal size / tier.

Tyler: Link: https://files.redwood/monarch/sig-2026.xlsx. No redlines yet. Expected tier: Enterprise (>$500k ARR potential).

Derek: I can own network/crypto controls (encryption, keys, network segmentation).

Priya: I can take app sec / IAM / access controls. Need architecture diagram, SSO metadata, and KMS evidence. Please upload to intake form: https://redwood.internal/sec-intake

sec-bot: New intake created: https://redwood.internal/intakes/2039876543 — status: untriaged — missing fields: kdiagram, sso_metadata, kms_evidence

Tyler: Uploaded diagram + SAML metadata to the intake just now. Also note customer asked if we offer on-prem as an option; they're EU-only workload. POC scheduled next week (Apr 12-14).

Priya: Got it. I'll start filling answers today. Quick Q: do we mark "on-prem available" = no, and offer Private (VPC/on-prem package) as an enterprise add-on?

Lina: Yes — recommend this wording: "Private (VPC) deployments are available; a fully on-prem, air-gapped install is offered as an enterprise add-on subject to procurement and professional services review."

Derek: Encryption at rest: we use AES-256 via cloud KMS, CMKs managed per-customer for Dedicated/Private. I'll attach KMS policy screenshot and CMK rotation doc.

Priya: For SSO: we support SAML 2.0 and OIDC. Uploaded SAML metadata and example IdP config (attached).

Tyler: Please add short sales-friendly summary we can send to customer. They need ETA for complete package + evidence.

Priya: Drafted summary in intake: "We support SAML 2.0/ OIDC SSO, AES-256 encryption at rest with customer-managed CMKs in Private/Dedicated, role-based access controls, and EU-region-only deployments via Private. On-prem installs are available as an enterprise add-on." Uploaded evidence: diagram.png, saml-metadata.xml, kms-screenshot.png.

Lina: Assigned owners updated in intake: Derek (network/crypto), Priya (app sec/IAM). Status -> in-review. ETA for completed SIG + evidence: Thu EOD.

Derek: Uploaded kms-screenshot.png and cmk-rotation.pdf. Marked answers for sections 3.2, 3.5.

Priya: Completed app-sec answers and linked design doc. Evidence may be redacted for public docs; put internal links where necessary.

Tyler: Fantastic. I'll tell the customer we expect full answers + evidence by Thu EOD. If anything slips, flag here and I'll push deadline. :thumbsup:

Lina: One more ask — can sales confirm if they need CAIQ formatted file or just a PDF? If CAIQ JSON required, we'll convert but need extra time.

Tyler: Customer asked for CAIQ export (machine-readable). Please prioritize CAIQ export if possible.

Priya: I'll generate CAIQ JSON after finishing controls, ETA 3-4 hours after answers complete.

sec-bot: Intake 2039876543 status changed -> assigned. Owners: Derek, Priya. ETA: 2039877200.

Tyler: Thanks everyone — will update the customer now with ETA and CAIQ note. Keep me posted if any blockers come up.
